en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a frontal view of a large, rectangular neoclassical/art‑deco style building with tall arched windows and circular medallions above them. The building stands at the top of a broad set of steps with flagpoles in the foreground. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge, including the name of the city and the art museum, a printer's mark, and collection information.
